tutorNotes.text: "Today, we're going to practice reading about people. We will read a team directory entry."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"

understand.instruction: Practice the sentence patterns first. Then review the word bank and pronunciation words.
understand.instructionKr: 먼저 문장 패턴을 연습하세요. 그런 다음 단어장과 발음 단어를 살펴보세요.

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's work on comprehension."

Correct the student's pronunciation errors if needed.

Practice the /ɪ/ words first, then the /iː/ words. Ask the student to repeat.
Teach the student how to pronounce /æ/ and /ʌ/ using mouth movements if needed.

steps.title: Step 1 — Read & Repeat
steps.instructionEn: Read each sentence from the team directory entry. Repeat after your tutor.
steps.instructionKr: 팀 디렉터리 정보의 각 문장을 읽어 봅시다. 선생님을 따라 반복하세요.
steps.content:
1. My name is Minji Kim.
2. I live in Seoul now.
3. I work at Global Corp.
4. I am an accountant in the finance team.
5. I like watching movies on weekends.
6. My hobby is taking photos.

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's read and repeat the team directory entry."
Read each sentence. Ask the student to repeat.
Focus on clear pronunciation of key words.
Adjust speed to the student's level. Repeat sentences as needed.
Good job! Let's go to the next part!
"Now, complete the sentences about Minji."
Read the instruction.
Ask the student to complete each sentence about Minji, then read the full answers aloud.
For lower-level students, let them look back at the entry while completing the sentences.
Nice! Let's go to the next part!

steps.title: Step 3 — Read a Second Entry
steps.instructionEn: Read the second team directory entry with your tutor.
steps.instructionKr: 두 번째 팀 디렉터리 정보를 선생님과 함께 읽어 봅시다.
steps.content: Hello! My name is Jisoo Park. I live in Incheon now. I work at Mirae Trade. I am a sales assistant. I like watching movies. My hobby is baking. Nice to meet you!

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's read a second team directory entry."
Read the instruction.
I will read the tutor parts, you will read the student parts
Then ask the comprehension questions in the dialogue.
Nice! Let's go to the next part!

steps.title: Step 4 — Complete Your Own Profile
steps.instructionEn: Complete your own team directory entry using the patterns.
steps.instructionKr: 패턴을 사용하여 자신의 팀 디렉터리 정보를 완성하세요.

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's make your own team directory entry!"
Read the instruction.
Ask the student to read and fill in the blanks with their own information.
For lower-level students, do it one line at a time.
Nice! Let's go to the next part!
